row.name: vw_project_lookups
row.definition: with "unique_config" as (select distinct on ("c"."project", "c"."key") "project", "key", "label", "value", "created_at", "updated_at", "version", "trace_id", "deleted_at", "environment" from "configs" "c") select "p"."id", "p"."name", "p"."image", "p"."organization", "p"."created_by", "m"."user_id", "u"."name" as "creator_name", "u"."image" as "creator_avatar", count("unique_config"."key") as "config_count" from "projects" "p" left join "unique_config" on ((("unique_config"."deleted_at" is null)) and ("unique_config"."project" = "p"."id")) left join "member" "m" on "m"."id" = "p"."created_by" left join "user" "u" on "u"."id" = "m"."user_id" group by "p"."id", "m"."user_id", "u"."name", "u"."image"
